testResults.name: alpaca-crypto-websocket-feed
testResults.result: 45 tests passed including five new crypto cases: deployment-managed pair sourcing from strategy universes with runtime_only network enforcement and feed=crypto setting validation, subscription and feed validation for BASE/QUOTE pairs, exact fractional Decimal prices and sizes through the JSON parse path with Parquet round-trip, rejection of non-pair event symbols, and reconnection across the UTC-day boundary with continuous sequence ids and no false staleness. The feed inherits SIP auth, backoff, and watchdog behavior, uses the v1beta3 crypto endpoint, applies no session gating (continuous UTC-day semantics), and crypto quotes carry no tape

testResults.name: repository-wide-quality-gates
testResults.result: Repository-wide Ruff lint, format check, ty type check, and the complete pytest suite passed with 978 tests after wave integration

limitations: Feed pairing contract requires AlpacaCryptoWebSocketFeed with AlpacaCryptoInbox; the shared SIP feed remains unchanged for equities
